metadata.description: A young man from Dhodia tribe in Gujarat has made a special wrist watch. This wrist watch is called tribal watch or indigenous watch by him. These watches are manufactured in a workshop in his village. He want to give a special message to the people of the world through these watches. He says that tribals are saving environment for ages, now every human being has this responsibility.
